title: Production of Magic States via $Z$ Bosons and Dark Photons
summary: The production of magic states is studied in two settings. The first is the electroweak (EW) sector of the Standard Model (SM). The second is an extension featuring a new broken $U(1)$ gauge symmetry and a Dirac fermion charged under it. This setup resembles a dark $U(1)$ scenario, with the additional fermion playing the role of a dark matter candidate that annihilates into SM particles through its coupling to the new gauge boson.
